opus.problem: Gives the word away alone. 'Israel loved this son' plus 'a robe of many colors' is the single most famous Joseph detail, so this clue is not medium hard.

Uses a minor detail (the oath about his bones) while best-known stories are left out: interpreting Pharaoh's dreams of seven cows and seven years of famine, and revealing himself to his brothers in Egypt. A known story should come before this small detail.
